# ----------------------------------------------------------------
# O(7) Once-Per-Year Seven Cultural Capitals Pulse & Lightweight Hybridization Check
# Strictly guarded with is_rebel_country = no (fx17 compliant) & global year deduplication.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------

yearly_country_pulse = {
	on_actions = {
		oe_cul2_yearly_capitals_pulse
		oe_cul2_yearly_hybridization_pulse
	}
}

oe_cul2_yearly_capitals_pulse = {
	trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		OR = {
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_cul2_cap_year }
			AND = {
				has_global_variable = oe_cul2_cap_year
				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_global_variable = oe_cul2_cap_year }
					global_var:oe_cul2_cap_year != current_year
				}
			}
		}
	}
	effect = {
		oe_cul2_evaluate_seven_capitals = yes
	}
}

oe_cul2_yearly_hybridization_pulse = {
	trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		OR = {
			has_or_had_tag = BYZ
			has_or_had_tag = ROM
			has_or_had_tag = TUR
			has_or_had_tag = VEN
			has_or_had_tag = GEN
			has_or_had_tag = NAP
			has_or_had_tag = CHI
			has_or_had_tag = YUA
			has_or_had_tag = MNG
			has_or_had_tag = MOS
			has_or_had_tag = RUS
			has_or_had_tag = NOV
			has_or_had_tag = GLH
			has_or_had_tag = SER
			has_or_had_tag = BUL
		}
	}
	effect = {
		oe_cul2_hybridization_yearly_check = yes
	}
}
